payload.title: The learning-event vocabulary is spelled twice: LEARNING_EVENT_KINDS is a hand-kept tuple beside the literals that _belief_event_type and three callers pass, no test ties them, and a kind missing from the tuple raises after the belief row is already appended
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/memory.py:2231-2238 (_belief_event_type returns three of the kinds as string literals)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/memory.py:707 (the belief row is appended first)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/memory.py:730-735 (the journal write follows, with the helper's kind)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/memory.py:1438-1442 (a second site: belief row appended, then the journal call with a literal kind)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/memory.py:1870-1871 (the owner raises on a kind outside the tuple)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/goldset.py:103 (a literal kind in the goldset caller)
aria-kernel/tests/test_learning_ledger_one_writer.py:44-47 (the test restates the five kinds; no test compares the literals callers pass with the tuple)
payload.rule_violated: One definition per vocabulary (ownership atlas learning_log family; CLAUDE.md tier 2, make the correct behaviour automatic)
payload.notes: Adding a sixth return value to _belief_event_type, or a typo in one of the call-site literals, passes import and every test that does not reach that branch. At run time record_learning_event raises GovernanceError at memory.py:1870-1871 after the belief row was appended at memory.py:707 (or 1438), so the belief is on beliefs.jsonl with no journal row and the exception leaves _record_belief. Not reachable today: all five literals are members of the tuple. Close condition: Derive the kinds from one definition (constants or a Literal alias that _belief_event_type, goldset and pr_tracking import and from which LEARNING_EVENT_KINDS is built) and add a test that every event_type literal passed to record_learning_event in aria_kernel, and every value _belief_event_type can return, is a member of LEARNING_EVENT_KINDS. Plan row: F1.1 (the reader half of ARIA-LOW-732 stays with F1.2). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
